changes: Implemented the Story 3 finding-ledger and runtime-evidence foundation: fenced atomic persistence, exact CAS/idempotency receipts, content-addressed runtime evidence, live authoritative mutation adapters, non-creating read-only trust loading and exact signed proposal validation. DEV closeout is currently completing the full Store authoritative-reader trust boundary; no downstream Applicability or Identity semantics are being implemented here.
usage: Before merge, run the worktree CLI: node bin/proof-or-stop.js finding_ledger_query --storyId=B-fe8f. Use the registered finding_runtime_evidence_run and finding_runtime_evidence_verify commands for execution receipts. The global CLI reflects local main until DONE merges this Story.
expectedOutcome: Valid Finding-system writes remain durable, uniquely identified and exactly-once; inconsistent or stale evidence cannot change authoritative Finding state. Read-only query and verification preserve the filesystem. The user receives Story 3 infrastructure, not the complete future dynamic applicability/deferral system.
actualTranscript: At ad0c1b79, official verification_evidence_refresh_stale completed 71/71 and committed dd22f13. Targeted proposal tests rejected407 invalid cases and accepted43 legal cases; projection-prefix tests rejected8 inconsistent cases and preserved valid batches. Independent review subsequently identified missing base-Finding and legacy-mirror reader trust checks; those are being handled in DEV. No current-round TEST or DONE completion is claimed.
outcomeDiff: Implementation and earlier targeted evidence are present, but final reader trust-boundary closure and fresh REVIEW/TEST/DONE evidence remain pending.
limitations: Story 3 supplies schema-neutral persistence and runtime receipts; effective assessment freshness policy and cross-story route semantics remain downstream responsibilities per plan sections9.1-9.4. Nonblocking observations have a traceable CLI-created owner at docs/story/drafts/finding-ledger-nonblocking-review-followups/; they are not signed deferrals. Corrupt authoritative-ledger reads intentionally fail closed. Performance observations remain unmeasured.
pitfalls: Do not reuse stale material-bound evidence by assertion. Run one pinned raw command per exact execution identity and preserve separate selector receipts. The legacy RED selector token currentFails=true is explicitly a legacyPinnedNegativeControl compatibility carrier; currentGreenPasses and corrupted-relation rejection determine admissibility, not the token alone. red_evidence_create is PLAN-only and bug_report is REVIEW/TEST-only despite older help; DEV repro_probe records historical candidate evidence but is not a DONE receipt. gap_log refused an unextendable B-META provenance chain, so the permitted draft fallback preserves follow-up accounting without repairing unrelated infrastructure.
